purpose: Distinguish inability to generate the benchmark signal on a realized tree geometry from noisy recovery after successful calibration.
responses: S3 calibration outcome: bracketed benchmark vs no bracket
maximum S3 pilot median effect over the frozen lambda grid for no-bracket systems
prune-only calibration outcome conditional on S3 calibration/recovery reaching that axis
primary_contrast: Probability of S3 CALIBRATION_NO_BRACKET for nominal categorical versus continuous systems.
secondary: Distribution of maximum attainable S3 pilot median effect among no-bracket systems, stratified by semantic_class.
interpretation_guard: A no-bracket result means the frozen generator-estimator-geometry combination could not attain the benchmark over the predeclared lambda range; it is not evidence of weak biological phylogenetic signal.
